versions.content: Service Name Rte_PartitionTerminated_<PID> Syntax void Rte_PartitionTerminated_<PID> ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x72 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Rte_PartitionTerminated is intended to notify the RTE that a given partition is terminated or is being restarted. Available via Rte.h
